title: Lives and Opinions of Eminent Philosophers, Book VI (The Cynics)

publication.publisher_or_container: Harvard University Press (Loeb Classical Library); Perseus and ToposText witnesses
publication.edition: trans. R. D. Hicks, 2 vols., 1925; work composed c. 3rd century CE

access.locator: https://www.topostext.org/work/221 (public-domain Greek text; Book VI consulted at §6.103ff)

verification.verification_notes: Work identity and status as the foremost surviving source for ancient Greek philosophy confirmed via Wikipedia API extract (Diogenes Laertius) on 2026-09-24; ToposText locator for Book VI consulted (section 6.103 seen); Hicks Loeb edition identified from catalog metadata. Book VI transmits the life, sayings, and practiced provocations of Diogenes of Sinope and the Cynic school. Greek text public domain; no passage reproduced.

limitations: Laertius compiles earlier reports without consistent critical evaluation; anecdote and doctrine are not cleanly separable, and the 1925 English is dated.

copyright.notes: Greek text public domain; 1925 Loeb translation may be under copyright in places and is not reproduced.
